screens.title: 1 · Projetos
screens.why: Every open project, nearest deadline first, with its time and its tasks.

pins.label: Time bar
pins.text: Each row's bar is time gone by, from the day it was created to the end of its deadline day. It turns red (dangerInk) once overdue, with 'atrasado N dias'.

pins.label: Tasks count
pins.text: '3 de 8': tasks done out of all of them. This is the only task progress shown; the bar is never about tasks.

pins.label: Order
pins.text: Nearest deadline first, then the ones with no deadline (no bar). Finished projects go under 'Concluídos', in grey.

pins.label: + on this tab
pins.text: On Projetos the + (AppFab) creates a project. On Tempo it still writes on the day.

screens.title: 2 · Novo projeto
screens.why: Built like the task sheet: a bare field, one row of controls, a check.

pins.label: Deadline
pins.text: Sem prazo / 1 semana / 1 mês. 'Sem prazo' comes first and is the default.

pins.label: Pick a day
pins.text: The calendar pill shows the deadline ('até seg, 16 nov'). Tapping it opens the wheel to pick any day; then no segment is selected.

pins.label: Create
pins.text: The check creates the project and leaves you on the list. It stays dimmed until there is a name.

screens.title: 3 · Projeto
screens.why: Built like a task page on top. Below, the tasks are Lista’s cards, filed the way Lista files its stages.

pins.label: Deadline
pins.text: Tap to pick another day. The name is edited in place, like a task’s.

pins.label: Controls
pins.text: −1 dia / +1 dia / ✓, like the running card’s −15 / +15 / ✓.

pins.label: Bar
pins.text: Time gone by: the 3px line a running block uses.

pins.label: Two spaces
pins.text: Tarefas · N | Notas, each with the full height.

pins.label: Stages
pins.text: Tasks are filed by where they are, under headings in Lista’s type: Só no projeto, Fazer em breve, Depois eu priorizo, N feitas. Empty ones are not drawn.

pins.label: Same card
pins.text: The card Lista draws: grey fill, title, and on the right its length, or its hours once it is on the day (with ‘amanhã’ / ‘dom’, since there are no day headings here).

pins.label: Nova tarefa
pins.text: Same sheet as anywhere (name + length). Lands in Só no projeto, so the backlog never floods.

pins.label: Done
pins.text: Done cards keep the shape, quieter, with a check mark before the title (where Tempo puts its pin and repeat marks).

screens.title: 4 · Onde fica esta tarefa?
screens.why: Tapping a card opens this: how a task reaches the day, comes back, or gets ticked off.

pins.label: Só no projeto
pins.text: Off the day. The current place gets the accent and a check.

pins.label: Backlog
pins.text: End of ‘Depois eu priorizo’ on Tempo, no hour.

pins.label: Queue
pins.text: End of the queue, like + on Fazer em breve.

pins.label: An hour
pins.text: Day + hour wheel; anchored there, waits to be begun.

pins.label: Feita
pins.text: Ticks it off; the card moves under N feitas.

screens.title: 5 · Sem prazo, Notas
screens.why: A project with no deadline, on its notes: free text, saved as you type.

pins.label: No deadline
pins.text: No bar and no ±1 dia, only ✓. 'Dar um prazo' opens the wheel.

pins.label: Notas
pins.text: Free text, saved like a task's notes: shortly after typing stops, on blur, and when the page closes.
